reason: Classified as a memory/context migration utility because its primary user-facing flow is importing chat history and memory from other AI agents into DeepSeek Harness sessions, implemented as a DSH plugin command and a CLI tool with list/run options and output-compatible logs.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于将其他 AI 代理的本地对话历史与记忆导入 DeepSeek Harness，转换为可在 DSH 中查看和继续的原生会话，并通过 /migrate 命令或命令行方式执行迁移。
summaries.en: This plugin helps import local chat history and memory from other AI agents into DeepSeek Harness as native DSH sessions, with either the /migrate command or a CLI interface.

capabilities: Reads chat transcripts and memory stores from local agent files and directories
Converts imported data into DeepSeek Harness JSONL session logs
Provides both in-app slash command and standalone CLI workflow for migration
Supports optional dry-run/list operations before writing

reasons.code: README describes importing chat history and memory from multiple agents into DeepSeek Harness, including list/run commands and writable output to DSH sessions.
Package metadata exposes a CLI binary and a DSH bundle entry, showing plugin installation plus command-line execution paths.
